description: Amazon DynamoDB serverless architecture: Single-Table Design, Composite Partition and Sort Keys (PK/SK), Global Secondary Indices (GSI), conditional writes, and RCU/WCU cost optimization.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Amazon DynamoDB Single-Table Design Architecture

Design ultra-fast, cost-optimized NoSQL databases in AWS DynamoDB using Single-Table conventions.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Map all entity access patterns into a Single-Table Design utilizing overloaded generic `PK` and `SK` keys.
- Enforce idempotency and optimistic locking using `ConditionExpression` on all write operations.
- Leverage sparse GSIs to index only the items requiring specific secondary lookup queries.
- Ensure uniform partition key distribution to prevent throttling and hot partition bottlenecks.
